steps.title: Shopping in Korean
steps.body: Korea is a shopper's paradise — from Dongdaemun's 24-hour fashion markets to sleek duty-free department stores and Olive Young K-beauty chains. The most important phrase: 얼마예요? (How much is it?). Most stores accept card payments, and bargaining is possible at traditional markets.

tip.label: Market culture
tip.text: At traditional markets (시장, sijang), asking 깎아 주세요 (Please lower the price) is expected and welcome. At department stores, prices are fixed. Knowing the difference avoids awkward moments.

steps.body_ja: 韓国は買い物天国―東大門の24時間ファッションマーケットから洗練された免税デパート、オリーブヤングのK-ビューティーチェーンまで。最重要フレーズ：얼마예요？（いくらですか？）。ほとんどの店でカード払い可能で、伝統市場では値引き交渉もできます。

tip_ja.label: 市場文化
tip_ja.text: 伝統市場（시장）では깎아 주세요（値引きしてください）と言うのが当然でむしろ歓迎されます。デパートは定価制です。違いを知ることで気まずい思いをしません。

steps.meaning: How much is it? — the most essential shopping phrase
steps.meaning_ja: いくらですか？― ショッピングで最重要フレーズ

steps.meaning: To buy — 이거 살게요 = I'll buy this
steps.meaning_ja: 買う ― 이거 살게요（これを買います）

steps.meaning: To sell — 뭐 파세요? = What do you sell?
steps.meaning_ja: 売る ― 뭐 파세요？（何を売っていますか？）

steps.meaning: Cheap / inexpensive — 너무 싸요! = It's so cheap!
steps.meaning_ja: 安い ― 너무 싸요！（すごく安い！）

steps.meaning: Expensive — 너무 비싸요 = It's too expensive
steps.meaning_ja: 高い（価格）― 너무 비싸요（高すぎます）

steps.meaning: Payment / checkout — 계산해주세요 = Please ring this up
steps.meaning_ja: お会計 / 支払い ― 계산해주세요（お会計をお願いします）

steps.meaning: Card (credit/debit) — 카드 돼요? = Do you accept card?
steps.meaning_ja: カード（クレジット/デビット）― 카드 돼요？（カードは使えますか？）

steps.meaning: Cash — 현금밖에 없어요 = I only have cash
steps.meaning_ja: 現金 ― 현금밖에 없어요（現金しかありません）

steps.meaning: Receipt — 영수증 주세요 = Please give me a receipt
steps.meaning_ja: レシート ― 영수증 주세요（レシートをください）

steps.meaning: Discount — 할인 있어요? = Is there a discount?
steps.meaning_ja: 割引 ― 할인 있어요？（割引はありますか？）

steps.meaning: Exchange (product) — 교환할 수 있어요? = Can I exchange this?
steps.meaning_ja: 交換（商品）― 교환할 수 있어요？（交換できますか？）

steps.meaning: Refund — 환불해 주세요 = Please give me a refund
steps.meaning_ja: 返金 ― 환불해 주세요（返金してください）

steps.meaning: Size — 이 사이즈 있어요? = Do you have this size?
steps.meaning_ja: サイズ ― 이 사이즈 있어요？（このサイズはありますか？）

steps.meaning: Please lower the price — the essential market bargaining phrase
steps.meaning_ja: 値引きしてください ― 市場での値段交渉フレーズ

steps.meaning: Wrapping / takeaway — 포장해 주세요 = Please wrap it / I'll take it to go
steps.meaning_ja: 包装 / 持ち帰り ― 포장해 주세요（包んでください／持ち帰りで）

steps.prompt: You want to know the price. What do you say?
steps.prompt_ja: 値段を聞きたいとき、何と言いますか？

steps.prompt: At a traditional market, which phrase can you use to negotiate?
steps.prompt_ja: 伝統市場で値引き交渉に使えるフレーズは？

steps.prompt: The item doesn't fit. You want to swap it for a different one. You ask for...
steps.prompt_ja: サイズが合いません。別のものと交換したいときに頼む言葉は？
비싸다はどういう意味ですか？

steps.title: Shopping Complete!
steps.message: 쇼핑 즐기세요! You're ready to shop in Korea — from bargaining at Namdaemun Market to smoothly paying at a department store. Your wallet will thank you for knowing 비싸요 and 싸요!
steps.message_ja: 쇼핑 즐기세요！韓国でのショッピングの準備ができました―南大門市場での値引き交渉からデパートでのスムーズな決済まで。비싸요と싸요を知っていれば財布も助かります！
